# Municipal Ordinance No. 04, Series of 1999

**Ordinance requiring house numbering in Pitogo, Quezon**

## Summary

This ordinance mandates all residential and commercial property owners in Pitogo, Quezon, to display a visible number on their buildings. The purpose is to facilitate easy identification of properties. It specifies guidelines for numbering, including odd numbers on the right side and even numbers on the left side of the street. A fine of Php 500.00 will be imposed for non-compliance.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** All residential or commercial houses must have a visible number.
2.  **Section 2.** The number must be placed on a visible part of the house.
3.  **Section 3.** Even numbers should be placed on the left side of the street.
4.  **Section 4.** A fine of Fifty Pesos (Php 50.00) will be collected by the Municipal Treasurer.
5.  **Section 5.** The owner of the residential or commercial house will be given two months to comply.
6.  **Section 6.** The Municipal Planning and Development Coordinator will implement and oversee the ordinance.
7.  **Section 7.** Any conflicting Municipal Ordinance or Resolution is repealed.
8.  **Penal Provision:** Any owner of a residential or commercial house who violates this ordinance will be fined Five Hundred Pesos (Php 500.00) or imprisoned at the discretion of the court.
9.  **Section 8.** This ordinance shall take effect ten (10) days after its posting.
